package.name: g1_local_planner
package.description: Linear MPC local trajectory tracker for the Unitree G1: consumes /nav/global_path, /nav/local_costmap, and TF (map->base_link) to emit body-frame velocity /cmd_vel. Solved as a Quadratic Program via OSQP at 20 Hz. ROS-free core (g1_local_planner_core) + thin I/O node.
package.author: Rohan
